title: Responsibility
status: draft: written 19 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 2 Christian Religious Education; not yet checked by a CRE teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child names items carried to school and how to care for them (Colossians 3:23).

floor.question: What time should you arrive at school?

steps: Display and count items carried to school.
Say how to care for each.

board.say: How do we care for this?

board.do: Wait for the child to say cover it and keep it in the bag.
Write a care tip beside each.

misconceptions.ask: You lose your ruler. Does it matter?
misconceptions.repair: Talk about what a ruler costs and what else that money buys.

misconceptions.ask: Where should you keep your books?
Who should take care of your books?
misconceptions.repair: Read Colossians 3:23. Each one cares for his own things.

misconceptions.ask: Why write your name on your books?
misconceptions.repair: Pick up an unlabelled pencil: whose is it?

checks.question: Name an item you carry to school.
How do you care for your books?
checks.answer: Cover them and keep them in the bag
